privileged_info_for_vlm: The source survey must be 'Lab Master Template'. The target survey must be 'Social Interaction Study 2024'. The exported file must be exactly '/home/ga/Documents/standard_demographics.lsg'. Question DEMO_AGE is type 'N' (Numerical). Question DEMO_EDU is type 'L' (List/Radio) with codes E1, E2, E3, E4, E5. Question DEMO_EMP is type 'Y' (Yes/No). In the final survey, 'Standard Demographics' must be the only group present.
